response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, avg_modelconf
  FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_modelconf > (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase)
),
reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
  q.brokrepstat AS brokrepstat,
  q.avg_modelconf AS avg_modelconf,
  q.avg_modelconf - (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) AS amount_above_overall_average,
  q.avg_modelconf / r.mean_qualifying_avg AS avg_divided_by_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN reference AS r
WHERE (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) IS NOT NULL
  AND r.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: “Above-average” compares each status average with the overall average of non-missing modelconf values across all cases. The qualifying-status reference is the arithmetic mean of the qualifying statuses’ averages, with each status weighted equally. NULL statuses form their own group.
